confirmed_removals.name: Banijay Entertainment
confirmed_removals.note: Paris-based subsidiary of Banijay Group N.V. and the world's largest international content producer (~130 production companies, EUR 3.2bn turnover), so a major, not a small indie; banijay.com is its official site.

confirmed_removals.name: Nippon TV
confirmed_removals.note: Nippon Television Network Corporation is a Tokyo commercial broadcast network under Nippon Television Holdings (itself within the Yomiuri Shimbun media conglomerate, and majority owner of Studio Ghibli since 2023); no domain was listed to verify.

confirmed_removals.name: MBC Group
confirmed_removals.note: Riyadh-headquartered Middle East multimedia conglomerate (19+ satellite channels, Shahid VOD) majority-controlled by Saudi state entities, with PIF acquiring a 54% stake; no domain was listed to verify.

clean.name: 5-Second Films
clean.note: Los Angeles comedy filmmaking collective that still runs 5secondfilms.com and posted new releases as recently as October 2025, though output is sporadic rather than on its old weekday schedule.
